title: Automate observability stack for Private installs: Prometheus/Grafana + log shipping + dashboards & alerts
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Private (VPC/on-prem) installs currently require manual steps to ship telemetry and install curated dashboards and alerts. This PR automates end-to-end observability for private installs: provisioning Prometheus (Cortex-compatible), Grafana with curated dashboards, log shipping via Fluent Bit to a configurable log backend (Loki/Elasticsearch), and opinionated alert rules. Changes include Helm chart updates, Terraform module wiring, installer hooks, upgrade/rollback compatibility, and docs. Scope: (1) new terraform module outputs and variables for observability resources; (2) Helm chart values and templates for Prometheus and Grafana tailored to private installs; (3) Fluent Bit configuration and DaemonSet template for log forwarding; (4) Grafana provisioning for dashboards and alerting rules; (5) installer CLI hooks to enable/disable observability components during upgrade/rollback; (6) migration docs and an automated smoke test. Checklist: - update terraform module variables and docs; - add helm values and templates for private defaults; - add Grafana dashboard JSONs and provisioning Yaml; - add alertmanager / alert rules and include SLO-based alerts recommended by SRE; - add Fluent Bit filter/parsers and example outputs for Loki/ES; - add installer preflight/rollback hooks and tests; - update README and quickstart; - CI runs for helm lint, terraform validate, integration smoke tests. Testing & rollout: validated in staging private cluster: Prometheus scrape targets, Grafana dashboards rendered, log shipping to Loki, alerts firing on synthetic load; performed a canary upgrade with rollback validation. Backwards compatibility: installer keeps observability optional (default: enabled for managed installs, disabled for air-gapped by default) and includes a safe rollback path that tears down only created resources when toggled. Linear/Jira: ENG-4821; SUP-1204. Release notes: Adds automated observability provisioning for private installs: Prometheus + Grafana + log shipping + dashboards + alerting, configurable via terraform/helm and optional at install time.

testing_instructions: Follow docs/private-installs/observability.md to enable observability via terraform var observability_enabled=true and helm values override.
Run installer preflight: installer/hooks/observability-enable.sh --dry-run to validate resources.
Apply in staging and run installer/tests/integration/test_observability_smoke.sh; verify Prometheus targets, Grafana dashboards, and that Fluent Bit forwards logs to configured backend.
Perform an installer upgrade with observability enabled and then trigger rollback path: installer/hooks/observability-rollback.sh to validate resource cleanup behavior.
